documents.text: ticket window and a narrow waiting area. Access to the island platforms is by means of a footbridge. Management of the station has been outsourced to the JR Kyushu Tetsudou Eigyou Co., a wholly owned subsidiary of JR Kyushu specialising in station services. It staffs the ticket counter which is equipped with a "Midori no Madoguchi" facility. The station was opened by Japanese Government Railways (JGR) on 20 April 1910 as an additional station on the existing Kagoshima Main Line track.
